camera.description: Initial orbit-camera pose in world coordinates.

parameter_descriptions.fov: Vertical field of view in degrees, greater than 0 and less than 180.
parameter_descriptions.target: Look-at point [x,y,z] in distance_unit; follows the Sun with this initial offset.

scenario.description: Accelerated Sun-Earth-Moon scene: 60 s spin, 120 s lunar orbit, 300 s solar orbit. Description fields are documentation and do not affect simulation.

auto_exposure.description: Deterministic incident-light metering for surface and planet cameras. Sensitivity rises on the night side to reveal moonlight; identical camera, scene and time give identical exposure without warm-up.

parameter_descriptions.enabled: Use automatic exposure for surface and planet orbit views. False uses lighting.exposure directly; the whole-system camera always uses manual exposure.
parameter_descriptions.max_exposure: Upper sensitivity bound, at least min_exposure and at most 1000000. Prevents tiny ambient fill from making a moonless night look like daylight.
parameter_descriptions.min_exposure: Positive lower bound on effective exposure, used in bright sunlight.
parameter_descriptions.star_exposure: Positive exposure at which decorative stars reach full visibility. Stars and the sky background fade at lower sensitivity.
parameter_descriptions.target_luminance: Desired linear luminance of an 18 percent gray surface, greater than 0 and at most 1. The meter uses local solar incidence plus reflected and ambient light; terrain shadows do not affect metering.

lighting.description: Direct sunlight retains surface-normal shading. Reflected sunlight is averaged over each receiving planet and reused for terrain and water.

parameter_descriptions.ambient_light: Uniform linear RGB fill light, 0..1. Keep this near zero with automatic exposure so a night without moonlight remains dark.
parameter_descriptions.auto_exposure: Camera sensitivity and star visibility, evaluated deterministically from the current surface location and light.
parameter_descriptions.exposure: Positive display multiplier up to 100. In automatic mode this is exposure compensation before sensitivity limits; otherwise it is fixed exposure. Exponential tone mapping and sRGB encoding prevent hard clipping.
parameter_descriptions.reference_distance: Display normalization distance in distance_unit. A nominal solar luminosity (M_bol about 4.74) gives unit irradiance here. This compensates for the miniature scene, independently of intrinsic luminosity.
parameter_descriptions.reflections_enabled: Enable one bounce of sunlight from other bodies. Reflection depends on albedo, color, phase, radius and both light-path distances; this averaged indirect light has no eclipses or terrain occlusion.
parameter_descriptions.shadows: Visibility of direct sunlight, tested per surface point against this planet's terrain.

shadows.description: Sun-facing depth maps let mountains block sunlight on terrain and water behind them. Maps follow each body's rotation and are shared across rendering passes.

parameter_descriptions.bias_texels: Depth comparison offset in shadow texels, 0..4, with extra slope compensation. Increase to reduce self-shadow speckles; excessive values detach shadows from mountains.
parameter_descriptions.enabled: Enable terrain shadows from direct sunlight. Ambient fill and averaged reflected moonlight remain visible in shadow.
parameter_descriptions.resolution: Depth map width and height per planet, a power of two from 256 to 4096. Higher values resolve smaller ridges but use more GPU time and memory.

parameter_descriptions.distance_unit: World distance unit: km or m. Radii, positions, orbit axes and camera altitude use this unit; fields ending in _m or _mps always use meters.
parameter_descriptions.lighting: Shared illumination and display exposure, evaluated from the current body positions.
parameter_descriptions.planets: All orbiting bodies, including moons. Each orbit.parent names another body; parent chains must end at the Sun.
parameter_descriptions.scenario_name: Name printed when the scenario is loaded.
parameter_descriptions.skybox: Procedural background stars; these do not illuminate planets.
parameter_descriptions.sun: The root body and the only self-emitting light source.
parameter_descriptions.surface_camera: Initial planet-fixed walking camera (key 2); also selects the body for planet orbit view (key 3).

planets.description: Earth with terrain, water and a tilted equator.
planets.name: earth

orbit.description: Orbit axes and orientation in the world frame; speed is calculated from masses, not supplied manually.

parameter_descriptions.ascending_node_deg: Orientation of the tilted orbital plane about world +Z, in degrees.
parameter_descriptions.inclination_deg: Orbital plane tilt from world XY in degrees, independent of parent spin.
parameter_descriptions.mean_anomaly_deg: Initial phase uniform in time: 0 degrees is periapsis, 180 degrees is apoapsis.
parameter_descriptions.parent: Name of the body orbited; must exist, differ from this body, and form an acyclic chain to the Sun.
parameter_descriptions.periapsis_deg: Rotation of the nearest point within the orbital plane, in degrees.
parameter_descriptions.semi_major_axis: Large ellipse half axis a in distance_unit. Combined parent and child-collective mass determines the stable orbital period from a.
parameter_descriptions.semi_minor_axis: Small ellipse half axis b in distance_unit; 0 < b <= a. Sets eccentricity and speed variation; b=a is a circle.

parameter_descriptions.atmosphere_enabled: Reserved atmosphere metadata; atmospheric scattering is not rendered yet.
parameter_descriptions.atmosphere_height: Reserved atmosphere thickness in distance_unit; currently has no visual effect.
parameter_descriptions.color: Linear RGB surface tint, each channel 0..1, multiplied by procedural terrain colors.
parameter_descriptions.mass_kg: Positive mass in kilograms. Descendant masses contribute to the outer orbital speed; relative masses set barycentric wobble.
parameter_descriptions.name: Unique body name; used by child orbit.parent fields.
parameter_descriptions.orbit: Kepler ellipse for the relative separation between the parent body and this body plus its descendants center of mass.
parameter_descriptions.reflection: Mean reflectivity and color for sunlight bounced toward other bodies, independent of local terrain details.
parameter_descriptions.rotation: Spin about the body north axis, independent of orbital phase.
parameter_descriptions.surface_noise: Additive planet-fixed height-noise layers; amplitudes are meters.
parameter_descriptions.terrain_landscape: Broad continental, plain and cliff height features, added to surface_noise.
parameter_descriptions.terrain_lod: Tessellation density and triangle budget selected from distance along the surface.
parameter_descriptions.water: Spherical water shell and its visual reflection of the scene.

reflection.description: Single-bounce Lambert-sphere approximation for the light this body sends to other bodies.

parameter_descriptions.color: RGB fractions of the reflected sunlight, each 0..1. Equal channels give neutral reflection; a larger blue channel tints the bounced light blue.
parameter_descriptions.geometric_albedo: Full-phase reflected brightness relative to a perfectly reflecting flat disk, 0..1; 0 disables this body as a reflector.

rotation.description: Planet-fixed rotation; T pauses and Y/U scale both spin and orbits.

parameter_descriptions.axial_tilt_deg: North-axis tilt about world +X, in degrees. Earth and the Moon use 20 degrees, matching the lunar inclination.
parameter_descriptions.period_seconds: Seconds per full axial turn at 1x simulation speed. Zero disables spin; negative values reverse it.
parameter_descriptions.phase_deg: Initial spin angle about the tilted body +Z axis, in degrees.

surface_noise.description: low freq noise responsible for hills

parameter_descriptions.amplitude_m: Nonnegative height amplitude in meters; layers add together.
parameter_descriptions.frequency: Base spatial frequency, greater than 0 and at most 64; higher values give smaller features.
parameter_descriptions.persistence: Amplitude multiplier between octaves, greater than 0 and at most 1; default 0.5.
parameter_descriptions.seed: Deterministic noise seed. Changing it changes this layer of terrain.
parameter_descriptions.type: value_fbm gives smooth hills; ridged_fbm gives sharp ridge relief.

surface_noise.description: fine ridge relief; broad cliff regions use terrain_landscape.seed

parameter_descriptions.amplitude_m: Nonnegative height amplitude in meters; layers add together.
parameter_descriptions.frequency: Base spatial frequency, greater than 0 and at most 64; higher values give smaller features.
parameter_descriptions.persistence: Amplitude multiplier between octaves, greater than 0 and at most 1; default 0.5.
parameter_descriptions.seed: Deterministic noise seed. Changing it changes this layer of terrain.
parameter_descriptions.type: value_fbm gives smooth hills; ridged_fbm gives sharp ridge relief.

terrain_landscape.description: Broad shapes. This block enables the landscape by default; its own seed controls continental and cliff placement.

parameter_descriptions.cliff_amplitude_m: Nonnegative cliff height amplitude in meters.
parameter_descriptions.cliff_frequency: Cliff noise frequency, greater than 0 and at most 32.
parameter_descriptions.cliff_threshold: Noise threshold for cliffs, greater than plain_threshold and less than 1.
parameter_descriptions.continent_amplitude_m: Nonnegative broad continental height amplitude in meters.
parameter_descriptions.continent_frequency: Broad shape frequency, greater than 0 and at most 16.
parameter_descriptions.elevation_offset_m: Base elevation offset in meters; negative values lower the terrain toward ocean basins.
parameter_descriptions.plain_threshold: Noise threshold below which broad regions become plains, between 0 and 1.
parameter_descriptions.ridge_smoothing: Rounds sharp ridge crests, 0..0.5; 0 preserves sharp crests.
parameter_descriptions.seed: Deterministic seed for broad continents and cliff regions.

terrain_lod.description: Adaptive surface detail. The triangle budget bounds mesh work as the camera moves.

parameter_descriptions.base_edge_segments: Far-zone subdivisions per base triangle edge, at least 1.
parameter_descriptions.lod_far_diameters: Legacy outer distance-test threshold in diameters; must exceed lod_near_diameters.
parameter_descriptions.lod_near_diameters: Legacy distance-test threshold in planet diameters; the renderer now uses surface-distance zones.
parameter_descriptions.max_edge_segments: Near-zone subdivisions per edge, up to 32.
parameter_descriptions.medium_edge_segments: Middle-zone subdivisions per edge, between base and max density.
parameter_descriptions.mid_surface_distance_m: Surface distance defining the outer edge of the middle zone, in meters; must exceed the near distance.
parameter_descriptions.near_surface_distance_m: Surface distance from the camera radial position defining the near zone, in meters.
parameter_descriptions.steep_edge_segments: Extra near/middle detail for steep faces, between max density and 32.

water.description: Sea shell. Its reflection_fraction controls the water image, separately from the body reflection/albedo used for moonlight.

parameter_descriptions.color: Linear RGB water color, each channel 0..1, illuminated by sunlight and reflected body light.
parameter_descriptions.enabled: Draw the water shell and keep the surface camera above it when true.
parameter_descriptions.level_m: Sea level relative to the reference sphere, in meters.
parameter_descriptions.opacity: Water alpha opacity, 0..1; opaque terrain above sea level still hides the water.
parameter_descriptions.reflection_fraction: Mix of lit water color and reflected scene image, 0..1.

planets.description: Moon orbiting in Earth's 20-degree equatorial plane and reflecting sunlight onto Earth.
planets.name: moon

parameter_descriptions.axial_tilt_deg: North-axis tilt about world +X, in degrees. Earth and the Moon use 20 degrees, matching the lunar inclination.
parameter_descriptions.period_seconds: Seconds per full axial turn at 1x simulation speed. Zero disables spin; negative values reverse it.
parameter_descriptions.phase_deg: Initial spin angle about the tilted body +Z axis, in degrees.

parameter_descriptions.amplitude_m: Nonnegative height amplitude in meters; layers add together.
parameter_descriptions.frequency: Base spatial frequency, greater than 0 and at most 64; higher values give smaller features.

parameter_descriptions.star_brightness: Display brightness multiplier for decorative stars, 0..20.
parameter_descriptions.star_color: RGB tint of the decorative stars, each channel 0..1.
parameter_descriptions.star_density: Fraction of procedural cells containing a star, 0..0.25.
parameter_descriptions.star_scale: Angular grid density, 1..10000; larger values create finer star cells.

sun.description: Brighter, nearly white Sun. Mass controls orbit timing; absolute magnitude independently controls emitted light.
sun.name: sun

parameter_descriptions.absolute_magnitude: Bolometric absolute magnitude M_bol, -30..30. Lower means brighter; subtracting 5 multiplies luminosity by 100. IAU luminosity is 3.0128e28 * 10^(-0.4*M_bol) watts; the real Sun is about 4.74.
parameter_descriptions.color: Linear RGB emission tint, each channel 0..1. Values near equal give white sunlight.
parameter_descriptions.mass_kg: Positive mass in kilograms; chosen with the planet masses for the configured orbital periods.
parameter_descriptions.name: Unique body name referenced by orbit.parent.
parameter_descriptions.position: Sun center [x,y,z] at time zero in distance_unit; the Sun subsequently recoils around the system barycenter.

surface_camera.description: Planet-fixed spherical North-East-Down (NED) camera. The saved local position and view follow orbit, tilt and spin.

parameter_descriptions.altitude: Requested eye clearance above terrain or water in distance_unit.
parameter_descriptions.direction_ned: Nonzero saved view direction [north,east,down] in the local tangent frame.
parameter_descriptions.fov: Vertical field of view in degrees, greater than 0 and less than 180.
parameter_descriptions.latitude_deg: Latitude in degrees, -90..90; +Z of the body is north.
parameter_descriptions.longitude_deg: Longitude in degrees, from body +X toward body +Y.
parameter_descriptions.planet_index: Zero-based index in planets for walking and planet orbit views.
parameter_descriptions.simulation_time_seconds: Finite simulation timestamp restored on startup and reload. Camera telemetry prints the current simulation time, including pause and Y/U speed changes. --simulation-time overrides this value.
parameter_descriptions.up_ned: Optional nonparallel view-up vector [north,east,down] for preserving camera roll.
parameter_descriptions.walk_speed_mps: Walking speed in meters per real second, greater than 0 and at most 100; unaffected by simulation speed.
